input_mode: Scripted ViewerActions only. Hardware keyboard/mouse messages, button states, accumulated deltas and cursor hover are discarded after Bevy InputSystems and before runtime Update controls. Native window/update settings are unchanged; the window may activate. This proof does not verify physical OS input delivery.
notes: Real native renderer. Original source records validated before app startup; OS bundle cache is warm. Acceptance is the first update observing the action ticket complete and loading false, before the three render-settlement frames. It includes action dispatch and worker publication, not screenshot work. Frame intervals are CPU update intervals, not GPU presentation latency. The bounded layout_job_timings records actual hit/miss/saved_exact/saved_repair decisions and matching action/revision IDs. Empty per-action layout_jobs means the action did not submit a layout job. Worker indexing, source lock wait, projection, restoration, solve and preparation residual are nonoverlapping; worker_total includes those stages. Publication wait, CPU acceptance, scene construction and save follow worker completion. These are CPU measurements and exclude deferred command application/GPU presentation. The cached step field is only an expectation; actual cache decisions are in layout_jobs. Cached geometry is compared exactly; all scenes are bounded to 250 representations.

persistence.scope: Synchronous main-thread state preparation and atomic save, including existing-state validation, serialization, file/directory fsync. Acceptance and frame intervals include this cost when enabled. The fresh temp directory is retained for inspection; no user state is read or written.

measurement_conditions: Apple M5, 16 GiB, macOS 26.6.2, Rust 1.96.0, optimized development profile. Four fresh processes ran sequentially after builds; both user previews remained open. Recently accessed bundles, OS cache uncontrolled; not disk-cold. Production used isolated persistence; scale proofs disabled persistence. Direct-action proofs discarded hardware keyboard/mouse input. Native focus behavior unchanged. CPU acceptance excludes render settlement/capture and GPU presentation; physical OS input is not tested.

phase_audit.tolerance: 64 floating-point ULPs of the largest duration, no wall-time overlap tolerance
